property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Block replication factor (1 for local single-node cluster).

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: Local filesystem path where NameNode stores filesystem metadata.

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Local filesystem path where DataNodes store data blocks.

property.name: dfs.permissions.enabled
property.description: Disable permission checking for simple local developer usage.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Enable WebHDFS REST API on port 9870 for direct HTTP ingestion.
